name: Continental Cable LLC
old_description: Continental Cable is a leading manufacturer of custom steel cable, wire rope, wire rope cable assemblies, cable hardware, and fittings.
about:
Continental Cable LLC operates from Hinsdale, New Hampshire, where it was founded in 1969. The company manufactures custom steel cable, wire rope, cable assemblies, hardware, fittings, and coated cable for industrial and commercial markets.

The facility employs 65 people and integrates swaging, stranding, extrusion, and machining capabilities to produce wire rope and cable assemblies in configurations ranging from miniature to heavy-duty galvanized and black-oxide finishes. A comprehensive inventory of wire rope hardware — including fittings, connectors, and accessories — is maintained for fast delivery, while custom hardware and plastic-coated cable jacketing are also offered. The company also supplies cable cutters, hydraulic swagers, and other tools for wire rope customization.

Continental Cable serves aerospace and military customers as a Qualified Producers List manufacturer for MIL-DTL-83420 and Federal Specification RR-W-410, and its products are used in automotive, medical, telecommunications, outdoor recreation, agriculture, fire safety, exercise equipment, and marine applications.

The company emphasizes its integrated manufacturing approach, AS9100 and ISO 9001 certifications, and a team-based operation focused on fast turnaround and competitive pricing.
